row.evidence: Backstory's help centre manages users manually, by CSV upload or by Salesforce role-hierarchy sync ("Automatic Mode"), with SAML SSO and JIT sign-up; no SCIM endpoint is documented and the Okta catalogue app supports SAML only.
row.notes: New row. People.ai rebranded as Backstory (people.ai redirects to backstory.ai; app still at app.people.ai). Quote-only pricing: customers pay per connected person whose activity is ingested plus answer consumption, with no feature tiers, so SAML SSO is in the single product. Users are managed manually, via CSV import, or synced from the Salesforce role hierarchy (Automatic Mode, changes within 30 minutes). SAML JIT creates users in an inactive state pending admin approval. Suspend revokes access and hides data; delete removes it. Okta OIN app (listed as People.ai) ticks SAML only. No SCIM found in the help-centre sitemap (141 English articles).
